summary: Connect stakeholder needs to verifiable system requirements and lifecycle decisions.
intents: define system requirements for a drone delivery platform
build an interface control document between subsystems
run a trade study for the sensor choice
plan verification and validation for the system
trace stakeholder needs to subsystem requirements
prerequisites: available architecture, constraints, standards, and interface information
verify: Every requirement traces to a stakeholder need and a verification method
Interfaces between subsystems are specified on both sides
Trade studies record criteria, weights and sensitivity
